# task recurrence until done

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:taskRecurrenceUntilDone`](gmeow-taskRecurrenceUntilDone.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/taskRecurrenceUntilDone>

- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Whether this recurring task continues until marked done, rather than stopping at a fixed count or end date.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:Task`](../classes/gmeow-Task.md) -> [`xsd:boolean`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:taskRecurrenceUntilDone`](gmeow-taskRecurrenceUntilDone.md) from [`gmeow:Task`](../classes/gmeow-Task.md) to [`xsd:boolean`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to flag a recurring task that re-arms until completed rather than ending at a fixed count or date — the 'keep nagging until done' pattern.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting two values (it is functional — one flag per task) and avoid using it for a fixed-count recurrence; that termination belongs in the [`gmeow:scheduleRecurrenceRule`](gmeow-scheduleRecurrenceRule.md).

### How to use

- Set the [xsd:boolean](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#boolean) true to make the task recur until its status reaches completed; leave it false or absent for a rule-bounded recurrence.

### Examples

- ex:waterPlants [`gmeow:taskRecurrenceUntilDone`](gmeow-taskRecurrenceUntilDone.md) true.
